messages.author: 66ed4f72a898a51c
messages.subject: SPDE book
parts:
Dear all,

This is a great pleasure to me to announce the SPDE book. This was made
possible thanks to the work of several colleagues. We have a web page at
http://www.r-inla.org/spde-book with more information and a online
(free) Gitbook version.

We hope it will be useful for those interested on applications involving
SPDE models and also an inspiration for those having an application at
hand that fits into this framework.

Best regards,

Elias

messages.author: cdaedda7d73defe4
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Re: SPDE book
parts:
Dear authors,

Thank you for this nice book. But I have a concer after looking through it.

Are all the models fitted by INLA approach spatial and paramatric/semi-prametric?

I am interesting in estimating survival time using semi-parametric and non-parametric Bayesian approaches.

For instance, is it possible to fit non-parametric survival models based on Dirichlet process or Polya tree distribution using INLA or SPDE approach?

Any insights on these questions will be very appreciated.

Cheers !

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Re: SPDE book
parts:
Hi & thanks for your email. The models we can do are those in the book,
whereas non-par bayes ones, we cannot do.

H
